description: This source file defines the 'Duration' class in the 'org.openmrs.logic' package, representing a time duration with various units and methods to convert to days or milliseconds. It provides static factory methods for different time units and implements the 'Operand' interface, indicating its use in logical operations within the OpenMRS logic framework.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Represents a duration of time with various units, supporting conversion to days and milliseconds, and used as an operand in logic comparisons.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the numeric value of the duration.

methods.name: getUnits
methods.description: Returns the units associated with the duration.

methods.name: getDurationInDays
methods.description: Calculates and returns the duration's equivalent in days.

methods.name: getDurationInMillis
methods.description: Calculates and returns the duration's equivalent in milliseconds.

methods.name: seconds
methods.description: Static factory method to create a Duration object representing seconds.

methods.name: minutes
methods.description: Static factory method to create a Duration object representing minutes.

methods.name: hours
methods.description: Static factory method to create a Duration object representing hours.

methods.name: days
methods.description: Static factory method to create a Duration object representing days.

methods.name: weeks
methods.description: Static factory method to create a Duration object representing weeks.

methods.name: months
methods.description: Static factory method to create a Duration object representing months.

methods.name: years
methods.description: Static factory method to create a Duration object representing years.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Indicates whether the Duration supports a given comparison operator, specifically 'WITHIN'.
